d:
Jharkhand vidhanasbha men SIR ke mudde par charcha ke dauran siyasi mahaul garma gaya. vidhayak pradip yadav ke bhashan ke bich bijepi pradesh adhyaksh babulal marandi apni sit se uth khare hue. unhonne saval kiya, "mera nam kyon le rahe hain?" aakhir sadan men kya huaa aur donon netaon ke bich kya batchit huee? dekhie pura vidiyo.
